answer: Split-tally harbor bonds block bulk fakes. Each locks 70 for 20 epochs and posts two halves at the harbor summing to 70 under one signed total; filing is 50. The clerk replays the tally each epoch; a forged half breaks the sum and burns. Each half is keyed to one berth; copied halves hit the reef and burn. 1,000 fakes pay 50,000 and lock 70,000 over a 20-epoch horizon vs a 40,000 pool. One honest agent pays 50 once, keeps its bond and share.
